name: Etheridge Lakes Data Center
summary: Chesapeake City Council unanimously denied the Etheridge Lakes rezoning after extensive public comment and an earlier Planning Commission recommendation against it.
proposal_description: The applicant sought to rezone a 22.6-acre parcel near Centerville Turnpike and Etheridge Manor Boulevard for a two-story data center.
site_afterlife: No verified replacement development on the parcel is published here. Chesapeake subsequently developed broader data-center policy, a distinct citywide outcome that should not be confused with parcel reuse.
evidence_note: The denial is final for the reviewed rezoning. Community testimony is well documented, but the record also cites land-use compatibility and availability of other viable uses.

timeline.title: Rezoning application begins review
timeline.summary: The city opened review of a proposal for a data center adjacent to established residential and agricultural uses.

timeline.title: Planning Commission recommends denial
timeline.summary: The commission recommended against the rezoning after extensive written opposition and public concern.

timeline.title: City Council unanimously denies rezoning
timeline.summary: Council denied the application 7–0 after public testimony, citing incompatibility with the location and community.

timeline.title: City adopts a broader data-center ordinance
timeline.summary: The city later adopted an ordinance governing future data-center siting. This is tracked as a policy consequence, not an economic effect of the rejected parcel.
